newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends little changed vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends little changed vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed little changed at 8.2923 on Wednesday from Tuesday's 8.2925 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai due to cautious market sentiment and slow trading with most investors sidelined, traders said.
The weighted average price on Tuesday was 8.2922.

The yuan opened slightly higher at 8.2922 and moved stably in a range from 8.2920 and the intraday low of 8.2925 for most of the session, hitting a high of 8.2915. Trading was dull with most business done at 8.2922, traders said.
One dealer said investors were cautious ahead of the middle of the month when Beijing is expected to announce foreign trade data for May.
"They would like to stay on the sidelines before the announcement but many believe China will continue to post strong foreign trade surplus figures in May," he said.
A second dealer said intervention by the central bank to depress the yuan on Thursday last week was another reason for investors to be cautious.
Traders said they expected the yuan to move narrrowly around the 8.2920 level on Thursday.
The yuan closed down sharply at 7.4590 from 7.3301 against 100 Japanese yen due to the yen's strong upward trend on the world foreign exchange markets.
It closed almost unchanged at 1.0706 from 1.0705 against the Hong Kong dollar.
